dimension_description: Counts are dimensionless tallies of discrete things or discrete possibilities: planets, genes, cells, books, stars, IPv6 addresses, or legal game states. Mixing literal inventories with combinatorial possibility spaces would be misleading if that distinction were hidden, so each entry says what is being counted. This scale is useful for comparing everyday finite sets with astronomical and computationally explosive counts on one logarithmic axis.
